gate_changes_reviewed.change: Evidence Analyst now prospectively requires deterministic exact-source scope, terminal mapping, and machine-readable handoff fields before semantic interpretation for the next Architecture object
Evidence Analyst now states that future successor allocation must fail closed when narrated machine fields disagree with the machine artifact, while preserving historical artifacts and labels
A generic machine-checkable handoff-binding Utility proposal now exists, but Control has not yet prospectively adopted or demonstrated it programme-wide
The v0.5 config Architecture object closed at HOLD after one fixed cycle with ordinary inactive-configuration/API/reproducibility reduction and no same-object rescue
The unit-suppression Discovery was exactly source-reduced for mechanism novelty but promoted only as a distinct intervention/API/testbed semantics question

false_positive_risks: Manual semantic transcription can overstate support breadth or criterion satisfaction even when artifact identity and top-level classification are correct
Incorrect lower-level summaries can influence successor design before detection unless machine-bound handoff validation is enforced
Architecture/API findings could be laundered into mechanistic novelty if claim-type boundaries are ignored
Stronger-privilege reduction ceilings could be mistaken for equal-resource mechanistic comparators
false_negative_risks: A fidelity safeguard would become overconservative if any prose mismatch automatically rejected the scientific object instead of blocking only interpretation-dependent continuation
Reacting to handoff defects with universal replication or stronger support requirements would suppress modest but useful Architecture/API/testbed questions
Using new-principle novelty as the threshold for engineering, reproducibility, intervention-semantics, API, or testbed value would recreate programme-wide overconservatism
Fitting a universal support threshold to completed Top-k outcomes would create post-outcome goalpost movement

notes: workflow/head/artifact provenance checks validate identity while semantic-summary validation checks interpreted machine content
one-way execution integrity does not guarantee correct durable handoff transcription
fresh Analyst review and machine-checkable handoff binding protect different failure stages

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: No historical artifact, label, threshold, allocation, identity, or consumed evidence was changed. The handoff guard and machine-readable binding requirements apply prospectively. Completed Temporal, Top-k and v0.5 outcomes remain unchanged.

required_path: support or uncertainty adequate to the local question
matched equal-privilege comparators for mechanistic claims
survive ordinary implementation and dynamical reductions
faithful machine-bound artifact ingestion and interpretation
pass_reachability_assessment.current_limit: No active PRE_FORMAL or FORMAL object. The generic handoff guard remains pending programme-wide Control adoption and end-to-end validation, but it is a procedural integrity safeguard rather than a new substantive novelty hurdle.

external_calibration.use_rule: External literature and audits calibrate prospective reductions and claim boundaries only; they do not override machine artifacts or rewrite consumed evidence.

opportunity_cost_assessment: The highest-value methodology action is now implementation and prospective validation of the narrow machine-checkable handoff guard. Additional substantive scientific strictness would address the wrong failure mode and unnecessarily reduce lower-funnel information gain.
prospective_recommendations: Keep the four-layer funnel, strict FORMAL novelty bar, comparator discipline, ordinary-reduction-first interpretation, and hard integrity floor unchanged.
Keep the new Evidence Analyst requirement that the next Architecture object bind machine-readable outcome/handoff fields before semantic interpretation.

Control Brain should prospectively disposition the generic handoff-binding guard proposal; acceptance should remain nonblocking for unrelated lower-funnel exploration but should protect interpretation-dependent successor allocation once the guard is available.
On mismatch, preserve the artifact as authority and block only successor allocation that depends on disputed fields until reconciliation; do not automatically reject the candidate.
Validate the guard on a real future outcome-bearing lower-funnel closure after implementation rather than by rerunning or relabeling completed experiments.
Keep the suppression continuation strictly as one fresh static contract/semantics Architecture object; do not replay its Discovery pulse diagnostic or reinterpret it as mechanism novelty.
Do not retroactively rescore, relabel, rerun, invalidate, or upgrade any consumed or completed experiment because of methodology recommendations.
